reported.title: Solenoid pulse is 1000 ms instead of 2500 ms
reported.description: PULSE_MS is defined as 1000 on line 7, but the spec requires a 2500 ms HIGH pulse on D8. The pulse-end check on line 79 uses this constant, so every pulse terminates early; measured evidence shows pulses lasting 1000 ms (e.g. "pulse from 825 ms lasted 1000 ms, expected 2500 ± 150 ms") across all scenarios. The retrigger-ignore logic on line 69 is correct, but the wrong duration makes the core function wrong. 5 of 5 pulse(s) had the wrong length: pulse from 825 ms lasted 1000 ms, expected 2500 ± 150 ms. A trigger at 1.20 s came during this pulse, which must not change its length.

judge_input.spec:
- Trigger on D2 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); glue solenoid on D8; armed LED on D11.
- A settled press as short as 30 ms starts a 2500 ms HIGH pulse on D8 within 120 ms.
- Retriggers during an active pulse are ignored.
- Debounce the trigger with 25 ms of stability.
- Keep D11 HIGH when idle and LOW while the solenoid pulse is active.
- Print `glue dots=<n> busy=<0|1>` every 500 ms.
